description: We are building "The Earth Information Jukebox" from Praia, Cape Verde! Our goal is to create a modern, intuitive, and multimedia web experience that transforms complex NASA Earth science data into engaging "tracks" that anyone can explore, visualize, and understand effortlessly. We are looking for creative minds—especially UI/UX designers, front-end developers, storytellers, and Earth science enthusiasts—who want to collaborate and turn satellite data into an accessible discovery tool!
